findings.description: ForwardKinematicsSolver assumes a fixed rotation order. While correct for the simulated machine, a more robust implementation should use a dynamic transformation graph.
ICP alignment in ClosedLoopMetrologyInversionEngine is currently limited to translation-only centroid matching. Rotation alignment is missing.
The IndependentManufacturingOracle correctly isolates from SECP engines, providing a genuine adversarial check.

reservation_details: Infrastructure for Closed-Loop Truth is established, but complexity of real-world 5-axis motion is only partially captured in the current analytical solvers.
